current_activity: Reconstituted from Parisian FFI in the Nevers region under General Billotte
notes: Event date: 1 October 1944 (Wikipedia). Event definition: The division is reconstituted on 1 October 1944, mainly from Parisian FFI and Francs-Tireurs et Partisans, in the Nevers region under General Pierre Billotte. Event support: one source family (Wikipedia). Wikipedia, 10th Infantry Division (France), section History: "After the Normandy landings, the division was reconstituted, mainly of troops of Parisian FFI/Francs-Tireurs and Partisans (French Communists) origin, on 1 October 1944, in the Nevers region under the command of General Pierre Billotte". Location: Nevers, Nièvre (new place) with a precision of 25 km. Location approximate: the point stands for the Nevers region; precision 25 km. Location support: the place is a representative point (inferred value): the source gives only the Nevers region; precision 25 km. Commander: General Pierre Billotte commands the division (Wikipedia).

current_activity: Colmar Pocket: units of the division police up the interior of the pocket
notes: Event date: 5-9 February 1945 (CMH Riviera to the Rhine, p. 551); the row carries the first day. Event definition: Between 5 and 9 February, as the American divisions redeploy north, units of the new 10th Infantry Division and the 4th Moroccan Mountain Division police up the interior of the Colmar Pocket in the west. Event support: two source families (the US Army official history (CMH) and Wikipedia). CMH Riviera to the Rhine ch. 29 p. 551: "Between 5 and 9 February, as the supporting American divisions redeployed northward, French forces finished cleaning out the pocket. In the north de Monsabert's forces swept the west side of the Rhine from Erstein to Marckolsheim, while in the west units of the new French 10th Infantry Division and the 4th Moroccan Mountain Division policed up the interior of the pocket"; Wikipedia, 10th Infantry Division (France), section History: "The division took part in the final liberation of the Colmar Pocket". Location: Colmar, Haut-Rhin with a precision of 10 km. Location approximate: the point stands for the interior of the pocket; precision 10 km. Location support: the place is a representative point (inferred value): the source gives only the interior of the pocket; Colmar is its centre; precision 10 km. Commander: General Pierre Billotte commands the division (Wikipedia).
